kmlib.compatibility_notice_feature_title: %s %s and switched one of its features off.
kmlib.compatibility_notice_feature_diagnosis: This is a fault in %s itself rather than a clash with another mod, so %s.
kmlib.compatibility_notice_diagnosis_unknown_v: The likely cause is that your %s is either:
kmlib.compatibility_notice_diagnosis_same_vers: Your %s reports the version this integration was built for, so %s.
kmlib.compatibility_notice_phrase_new_and_carr: it's new and carries changes to public contracts
kmlib.compatibility_notice_phrase_report_to_de: it's better to report this issue to the %s developer
kmlib.compatibility_notice_action_update: needs to be updated to at least %s
kmlib.compatibility_notice_action_downgrade_or: either downgrade %s to %s or wait for a %s update
kmlib.compatibility_lost_lunalib_settings: KMLib's own settings will not take effect this session - the library logs at its default verbosity whatever the settings screen shows.
kmlib.compatibility_unaffected_lunalib_setting: On any other mod's settings, and on your save.
kmlib.compatibility_lost_nexerelin_routines: Colonies founded or handed over through mods depending on KMLib will follow the game's own rules this session rather than Nexerelin's. Saves made after this point may persist incomplete data.
kmlib.compatibility_unaffected_nexerelin_routi: On Nexerelin itself, and on mods that integrate with Nexerelin outside of KMLib.
kmlib.compatibility_lost_nexerelin_alliances: All mods depending on KMLib will read no Nexerelin alliances this session.
kmlib.compatibility_unaffected_nexerelin_allia: On Nexerelin itself, on mods that integrate with Nexerelin outside of KMLib, and on your save.
kmlib.compatibility_lost_nexerelin_colony_tran: No mod depending on KMLib will be told this session when a colony changes hands through Nexerelin.
kmlib.compatibility_unaffected_nexerelin_colon: On Nexerelin itself, on mods that integrate with Nexerelin outside of KMLib, and on your save.
kmlib.compatibility_lost_rat_access_routes: Star systems reachable only through Random Assortment of Things' own routes will be read as cut off by KM mods this session.
kmlib.compatibility_unaffected_rat_access_rout: On those routes themselves, which still carry a fleet in play, and on your save.
kmlib.console_factions_written_to_log: Faction listing written to the game log.
kmlib.console_gate_activated: Activated gate '%s' in %s; it lights up on its next advance.
kmlib.console_parameter_flag_given_value: '%s' is a flag; give it on its own, without '='.
kmlib.console_parameter_standalone_combined: '%s' cannot be combined with other arguments. %s
kmlib.console_profiling_expected_top: a whole number of rows above zero
kmlib.console_profiling_timings_logged: %s timings written to the game log (starsector-core/starsector.log).
kmlib.console_requires_campaign: This command can only run in a campaign.
kmlib.console_requires_star_system: This command must be run inside a star system.
kmlib.console_spawn_ambiguous_focus: This system has %d stars (%s). Re-run with a focus ID - one of those star IDs, or any entity ID in the system.
kmlib.console_spawn_expected_speed: a number in degrees per day
kmlib.console_spawn_gate_added: Added an inactive gate (ID %s) at your fleet position. Activate it with the gate-activation command and this ID.
kmlib.console_spawn_jump_point_added: Spawned %s at your fleet position in %s, generated its hyperspace entrance, and cleared the cut-off tag.
kmlib.console_spoilers_heading: Map spoilers - cut-off systems and undiscovered markets:

kmlib.console_target_no_sector_for_factions: No sector to read factions from.
kmlib.console_target_no_star_system: Not in a star system - name an entity ID to point at a place directly.
